data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 66.5m (2019: profit GBP 31.2m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 33.5m for prior accident years (2019: GBP 18.5m deficit). This included a deficit of GBP 20.3m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 13.2m on direct business (2019: deficit of GBP 22.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 4.3m on direct business).

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2020 subrogation impact of the wildfire events; 2020 income statement impact shown as a gross loss improvement of GBP 19.7m and a net loss deterioration of GBP 18.3m.
Prior year marine loss from a vessel grounding where the ground up loss estimate increased through 2020, accounted for GBP 16.8m gross and GBP 5.2m net of the prior accident year losses.

named_events.loss_description: One of two notable events in 2020 (with COVID-19); combined impact across both events was a gross loss of GBP 33.2m and net loss of GBP 27.2m.
Part of combined 2020 catastrophe impact (with Hurricane Laura); combined gross GBP 33.2m and net GBP 27.2m. Described as a 'live Cat' with ongoing impact into 2021.
2020 subrogation impact gave a gross loss improvement of GBP 19.7m and a net loss deterioration of GBP 18.3m.
Grounding resulted in an increased ground up loss estimate through 2020, accounted for GBP 16.8m gross and GBP 5.2m net of prior accident year losses.

data.standardized_narrative: Prior accident year reserves deteriorated by a gross GBP 33.5m in 2020 (a run-off deficit), driven by a GBP 20.3m deficit on reinsurance acceptance business and a GBP 13.2m deficit on direct business. Key contributors cited include subrogation activity related to prior wildfire events (notably Camp Wildfire) and an adverse development on the prior-year marine loss Golden Ray; reinsurance and subrogation dynamics also materially affected the net outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: run-off deficit of GBP 33.5m for prior accident years
deficit of GBP 20.3m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 13.2m on direct business

The prior accident year loss ratio of 7.4% is being driven by the 2020 subrogation impact of the wildfire loss events most notably Camp Wildfire (18K) and where the events fall within the Ascot reinsurance program.
The 2020 income statement impact for this event is a gross loss improvement of GBP 19.7m and a net loss deterioration of GBP 18.3m.

a prior year marine loss - Golden Ray (19YN) resulting from a vessel grounding whereby the ground up loss estimate of the event has increased through 2020, this accounted for GBP 16.8m gross and GBP 5.2m net of the prior accident year losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross GBP 33.5m) taken from note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states the gross run-off deficit and breaks it down by reinsurance acceptance and direct business. The claims development triangle (gross) shows current estimates that match prior diagonals for older years, so triangle did not indicate additional movement; narrative note used as primary source. Some event impacts are reported as gross vs net inconsistently (e.g. Camp Wildfire: gross improvement but net deterioration) - gross figures used where available. Mapping of events to standard LOBs is inferred from event descriptions (e.g. wildfiresProperty, vessel groundingMarine).
